Purpose                                                          目的
The purpose of the 2024 First Share Incentive Plan is to         2024年第一股份激勵計劃旨在為本公司提供
provide the Company with a flexible means of remunerating,       靈活的薪酬、激勵、挽留、獎勵、補償及╱
incentivizing, retaining, rewarding, compensating and/           或向合資格參與者提供福利的方式；透過向
or providing benefits to eligible participants; to align the     合資格參與者提供收購本公司股權的機會，
interests of eligible participants with those of the Company     使彼等的利益與本公司及股東的利益一致；
and the Shareholders by providing such eligible participants     並鼓勵合資格參與者為本公司的長遠增長及
with the opportunity to acquire shareholding interests in        盈利能力作出貢獻，以及為本公司及股東的
the Company; and to encourage eligible participants to           整體利益提升本公司及其股份之價值。
contribute to the long-term growth and profitability of the
Company and to enhance the value of the Company and its
Shares for the benefit of the Company and the Shareholders
as a whole.

               low credit risk.

               would expose the Group to credit risk.                        臨信貸風險的擔保。
